title: Mothlight handoff crib
content:
Purpose:
Quick handoff for the 11pm-7am shift. Meant to be a compact crib (notes to self + ephemeral procedures) for whoever takes over. Not canonical runbook — update main playbook if a step stabilizes.

State summary (start of shift):
- All core systems green except intermittent 503s on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (see INC-4521).
- Dedicated pool for customer ACME-reserved is at 72% utilization. No autoscale events so far.
- Observability: median token-latency ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 360ms.
- Recent deploy: runtime v2.14.3 rolled at 18:10 UTC with feature flag 'kv-prefetch' enabled for canary (10% traffic).

Open incidents / tickets to watch:
- INC-4521: transient 503s from model-router -> grpc-proxy. Triggered ~ 23:03 UTC.
  - Current mitigation: fallback routing to model-variant-1 (cold) is enabled for affected routes; metric for errors reduced but latency spiked ~ +120ms.
  - Next action: if errors climb past 5% for 15m, rollback kv-prefetch in canary pool (ticket owner Jonah).
- TASK-1892: backlog shard growth on redis-cache - replica lag up to 7s. Watch replication_lag dashboards.

Quick triage checklist (first 10 min):
1) Check paged alerts channel (#oncall-alerts) for any new tags.
2) Pager duty: acknowledge any new pages, escalate if >2 P1s active.
3) Open Grafana pinned dashboard (Oncall Overview) - look at error rate, latency, infra capacity.
4) For 503s: curl health endpoint on gateway node and grpc-proxy.
   - curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://gateway-eu-west-1.redwood/api/health
   - kubectl -n runtime logs deploy/grpc-proxy -c proxy --since=15m | tail -n 200
5) If rollback needed: kubectl set image deploy/serving-runtime serving-runtime=registry.redwood/v2.14.2 --record (confirm with SRE oncall before applying).

Temporary workaround snippets (ephemeral — do NOT commit to main repo):
- Force fallback routing by flipping route flag (console only, quick path):
  1) Console -> Routing -> model-router-eu -> edit policy -> add: "prefer_variant: model-variant-1" -> save.
  2) Verify via metrics: routing_fallback_count{region="eu-west-1"}
- Quick restart of grpc-proxy (if stuck calls present):
  kubectl rollout restart deployment/grpc-proxy -n runtime --timeout=120s

Escalation matrix (if problem persists >30m or customer impact P1):
- Primary SRE oncall: @jonah-park (Slack) / PagerDuty: PD-JP
- Runtime lead: @samira (Slack)
- Eng infra: @leo-chen (Slack)
- Product contact for ACME: acct-acme@redwood.ai (use when >10% of ACME requests affected)

Known quirks and TODOs (notes to future self):
- Can't trust gateway health endpoint alone — it returns 200 while proxy shows gRPC backlog. Prefer proxy metrics.
- The redis-cache replica lag flares after big bulk-evictions. Need a follow-up with infra to tune eviction policy (TASK-1892).
- Add a small synthetic check for route fallback behavior (missing today).

Session log (not exhaustive):
- 22:58 — noticed first spike in grpc-proxy errors, created INC-4521.
- 23:03 — enabled fallback for affected routes; error rate dropped but p95 latency rose.
- 00:15 — restarted a stuck grpc-proxy pod in canary; transient improvement for 12 minutes.

Handoff checklist to next oncall:
- Confirm INC-4521 status and whether rollback happened.
- Note if ACME sees any SLA breaches — if yes, ping product.
- Copy any new errors into the incident doc (linked).
- If escalation occurred, paste PD logs into incident thread (helps postmortem).

Personal runes (tips):
- For chasing 503s: always pull the last 3 deploys' admission logs — they show the feature-flag enable timestamps.
- Use the "prefetch=false" header in test requests to simulate older behavior quickly.

Unresolved questions:
- Why did replica lag spike exactly at 22:50? correlating with cache-eviction logs (needs deeper trace).
- Is kv-prefetch interacting poorly with the canary autoscaler? (Samira to follow up)

If you take over: say hi in #oncall-handoff; drop a one-line status update when you pick up (eg: "taking mothlight 11pm-7am; watching INC-4521").

End of crib — ephemeral notes; trim or move relevant steps into centralized runbook if they become stable.
